answer: Every identity starts its voyage by linking one paid subscription: a $20 monthly cloud bill whose invoice hash the network checks each week. One person can buy one subscription, but a Sybil farm needs one per identity, so 1,000 fake agents cost $20,000 every month, plus 3 days of waiting before each new identity can earn. If the bill lapses, the identity goes dark at once, like a willow branch cut from its trunk, and its balance stays frozen for 30 days. Each subscription maps to one identity only, so a single opal of proof cannot be passed around the farm.
